candidates.reason: Sensible stacked layout with a strong headline, but the logo is tiny and wedged into the top-left corner. The badge and CTA are offset from each other instead of sharing an edge. The CTA sits almost on the bottom edge and runs close to the right edge, leaving the right column cramped while the area under the headline is empty.

The hierarchy is inverted: the enlarged logo is now the dominant focal point and the headline is shrunk to secondary size. The badge is very small and far from the CTA. The CTA is undersized, and the right column floats with uneven gaps.

The original strip is pasted unchanged into the vertical middle, with about 60px of dead band above and below. Nothing is rearranged for the taller canvas, and the logo, headline and CTA stay at their small banner sizes.

The headline is jammed against the top edge with no margin, and the CTA butts against the badge with no gutter. The CTA also nearly touches the right edge. The logo is tiny and stranded at the left-middle, and the right-heavy pile-up leaves the lower left empty.
